spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the point-cloud splatting and migration use case for atomic-vec2u-min-max: replacing 16-bit packed u32 atomics (which suffer Z-fighting) and 32-bit CAS spin-loops with single-instruction 64-bit atomicMin on atomic<vec2u>.

interactive.rationale: Users can vary splat overdraw contention (2..64 splats/pixel), camera far-plane distance (50..5000m), and WGSL kernel implementations, with live SVG contention bar chart and Z-step precision readout.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index description of a point-cloud splatting & HDR reduction analyzer comparing 32-bit CAS spin-loops against 64-bit atomicMin/atomicMax.

edge_cases.rationale: Includes a 64-splat/pixel high-contention hotspot preset at 2500m far plane where 16-bit depth quantization degrades to 38.15mm steps while 64-bit vec2u preserves 0.00058mm resolution.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/4882016087703552, the W3C WebGPU spec, and WGSL issue #5071.

conformance.rationale: Probes navigator.gpu and adapter.features.has('atomic-vec2u-min-max') and generates spec-compliant WGSL enable atomic_vec2u_min_max code.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified overdraw slider, far-plane distance slider, kernel selector, and hotspot button with zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry assertion for the WebGPU adapter probe and updates contention metrics in real time.

design_system.rationale: Uses only CSS variables from /public/styles.css with zero raw hex or rgba literals.

accessibility.rationale: SVG chart has role=img and aria-label, all form inputs have explicit labels and 44px height, and the comparison table and aria-live output expose all metrics textually.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive control grid and viewBox-scaled SVG chart prevent horizontal overflow on 360px mobile and 1280px desktop screens.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Synchronize graphical chart updates with accessible DOM tables and live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Mirrored the SVG contention bar chart in a 4-row architecture comparison table and aria-live output.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide keyboard-operable preset buttons for stress-test configurations.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added a 44px Simulate Dense Splat Hotspot button.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure SVG charts include role=img and descriptive aria-labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied role=img and aria-label on the contention comparison SVG chart.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap range and select inputs in explicit labels with 44px minimum height.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped all three controls in semantic <label class='ctrl-card'> containers with min-height: 44px.

summary: Interactive point-cloud splatting and CAS contention analyzer comparing 32-bit packed u32 and CAS spin-loops against 64-bit atomicMin on atomic<vec2u>.
